## ValueTypeConstructors.date() method

A point in time: a `Date` in the SDK, ISO 8601 text with three fractional digits on the wire. Encoding emits `Z`<!-- -->; decoding honors any explicit offset. Dates must lie in years `0000..9999` (UTC).

**Signature:**

```typescript
date(options?: ValueTypeOptions): ValueType<Date>;
```
